Issue: Tracker promotes unsupported detailed requirements as officially confirmed
Implementation: Withdrew all 35 unsupported tracker milestones and rewards; retained local progress and export.
Verification: Tracker has a transparent empty state and no claimed completion percentage.
Remaining: Verified game requirements still need source review before being added.

Issue: Ten published guides have no substantive guide body
Implementation: Excluded all ten bodyless guides from public listings and sitemap; noindex on incomplete detail pages; added body editing and publish validation.
Verification: HTTP check confirms incomplete guide status; reading-time and publication-gate regressions pass.
Remaining: The ten guides remain unpublished-quality placeholders until real reviewed bodies are written.

Issue: Database confidence labels apply too broadly
Implementation: Added field-specific evidence registry; withheld unsupported numeric catalog values, rankings and loadout scores; comparisons retain unknowns.
Verification: Evidence tests, search-index HTTP checks and public detail noindex checks pass.
Remaining: No model-wide confidence badge can establish statistics. A reviewer must populate field sources.

Issue: Simulator warnings contradict confirmed earnings assertions
Implementation: Replaced named economy presets with editable examples; fixed zero income, zero time, losses, break-even and undefined ROI.
Verification: Finance edge cases pass unit tests; browser confirms zero-income Not reachable output.
Remaining: Outputs remain illustrative assumptions rather than GTA VI economy facts.

Issue: Radio hub contradicts the site’s newer radio reporting
Implementation: Replaced legacy radio data with the six stations shown in the current Rockstar preview and linked the source.
Verification: HTTP check confirms six sourced station names and the official music link.
Remaining: A station preview does not establish a complete final soundtrack or frequencies.

Issue: Malformed Markdown is visible in an article heading and TOC
Implementation: Corrected the stored launch-trailer heading; added render repair, matching TOC IDs and publication checks for unclosed heading links.
Verification: CMS correction read back; Markdown and TOC tests pass.
Remaining: Stored correction is live data; the new publication guard still needs the code release.

Issue: Priority article uses a 140×76 image
Implementation: Replaced the 140x76 apartment thumbnail with credited official Port Gellhorn 01 imagery, 3840x2160; local optimized copy and consistent social card.
Verification: Image inspected visually; HTTP checks confirm shared OG/Twitter asset and true dimensions.
Remaining: Operator must confirm image-use rights. Attribution does not itself establish permission.

Issue: Publication and author accountability are not explained
Implementation: Added team, editorial-policy and corrections pages; identified Taish Gaming as based in Pakistan using the owner's statement.
Verification: Profile and policy routes pass HTTP checks; no invented biographies or credentials.
Remaining: Individual author biographies, postal contact details and any legal entity identity have not been supplied.

Issue: Local production dependency audit flags critical Next.js advisory
Implementation: Upgraded Next.js to 15.5.28 and compatible patched Supabase, image and CSS dependencies; retained supported framework major.
Verification: Final npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities across production and development dependencies; release build passes.
Remaining: Production runtime changes only after deployment. Rotate any token exposed in chat.

Issue: The workspace is not a verified copy of the live deployment
Implementation: Confirmed production repository and deployed d06588dd baseline; isolated work in codex/audit-remediation.
Verification: Latest readable GitHub deployments and main still match the baseline; original working copy preserved.
Remaining: Never reset the original checkout, which contained pre-existing user modifications.

Issue: Parallel indexable database interfaces target the same entities
Implementation: Retained desktop catalog headers; consolidated useful search, category, saved/history and comparison features before legacy route redirects.
Verification: HTTP checks confirm permanent redirects; mobile interaction checks cover core catalog actions.
Remaining: New cosmetic redesign is held. Unknown-data charts are withheld for editorial integrity.

Issue: Many crawlable indexable pages are absent from the sitemap
Implementation: Sitemap now uses published article dates, qualified guides, reviewed catalog entries and durable profiles; no synthetic daily lastmod.
Verification: HTTP quality gate checks canonical routes, duplicates and excluded incomplete/app URLs.
Remaining: Catalog details enter the sitemap only when appearance evidence is reviewed.

Issue: Two public content paths lack incoming raw HTML links from the homepage graph
Implementation: Canonical weapon hub remains linked; duplicate database route redirects; bodyless best-weapons guide is excluded rather than promoted.
Verification: Footer/hub anchors and sitemap exclusion reviewed.
Remaining: Do not add links solely to rescue an empty guide.

Issue: An internally linked news URL returns HTTP 200 before rendering a not-found page
Implementation: Removed the stale Easter-eggs article link and streaming loading boundaries that hid not-found responses.
Verification: Four genuine missing news/catalog paths return HTTP 404 with noindex.
Remaining: A transient article backend failure throws an error rather than pretending the URL is gone.

Issue: Article template loads slowly in mobile lab run
Implementation: Made public reads cookie-free and deduplicated; enabled runtime ISR for article slugs with explicit invalidation; optimized the priority image.
Verification: Production-mode HTTP check confirms public caching without Set-Cookie or private/no-store.
Remaining: Field Core Web Vitals still require real production traffic after rollout.

Issue: Homepage hydration/main-thread cost is material
Implementation: Removed the bundled canonical catalog from global-search fallback; deferred map and dossier code until near the viewport.
Verification: Release build reports cached homepage and separated dynamic islands; lab evidence retained.
Remaining: Local build sizes are not a claim of improved production rankings or field performance.

Issue: Light-theme text fails measured contrast
Implementation: Darkened muted and small-label colors and corrected calculator contrast; preserved navbar source per owner's instruction.
Verification: Sample mobile light/dark audits retained; active desktop navigation must be reported separately.
Remaining: The original active-navigation color is deliberately unchanged. This finding is not fully closed.

Issue: Five calculator controls lack accessible field names
Implementation: Bound visible labels to all five savings controls and ten business controls; slider exposes its visible name.
Verification: Browser accessibility snapshot names the controls; focused calculator checks pass.
Remaining: Further accessibility coverage should continue on other legacy tools.

Issue: A homepage map pin overlaps the map CTA
Implementation: Removed the CTA from the map pin layer; enlarged pins and map controls; deferred below-fold map loading.
Verification: Map geometry and mobile target sizes inspected; no CTA banner remains over pins.
Remaining: Fan-map coordinates do not become verified game locations by this UI fix.

Issue: Countdown labels omit parts of visible button labels
Implementation: Changed countdown cells to readable text rather than misleading interactive controls; removed per-second announcements and unsupported preload/timezone claims.
Verification: Mobile snapshot and accessibility checks cover labels and stable region name.
Remaining: Timer targets the release calendar date at 00:00 UTC, not a verified regional unlock.

Issue: Character dossiers rely on JS interactions rather than durable profile pages
Implementation: Added durable server-rendered profiles for all eight known character entries and ordinary links from character cards and home dossiers.
Verification: Jason route and profile discovery checked; official background summaries cite Rockstar.
Remaining: Profiles intentionally avoid unsupported actor, ability or mission-reward claims.

Issue: Author identity and publisher logo metadata are inaccurate
Implementation: Separated publication brand from SEO titles; used team Organization identity and an actual Taish Gaming logo asset.
Verification: Article HTTP check confirms publisher logo; global author metadata reviewed.
Remaining: A shared team byline is not a verified individual person's biography.

Issue: Schema conveys speculative game instructions and property listings
Implementation: Removed HowTo and RealEstateListing types from speculative mission/property pages; retained cautious editorial WebPage descriptions.
Verification: Source review and successful build confirm schema replacement.
Remaining: Speculative pages remain excluded from indexing; no actual real-estate offer is asserted.

Issue: Some hubs use different OG and Twitter images
Implementation: Aligned hub and priority-article OG/Twitter images; removed invented dimensions and declared true priority-image dimensions.
Verification: Priority article social-image consistency passes HTTP checks.
Remaining: Legacy assets require a broader rights and provenance inventory.

Issue: Large-image preview permission is absent in sampled meta/header directives
Implementation: Added max-image-preview:large for public editorial pages while retaining noindex on incomplete/private content.
Verification: Article robots output and incomplete-guide noindex pass HTTP checks.
Remaining: Large-preview permission does not guarantee Discover inclusion.

Issue: Live CSP only controls embedding
Implementation: Added a resource CSP in Report-Only mode, bounded privacy-sanitized reports and preserved embedding for public widgets.
Verification: Header, report endpoint and embedding HTTP checks pass.
Remaining: Script policy still permits inline scripts. Collect production reports, implement hashes/nonces as compatible, then enforce tested directives.

Issue: Privacy text does not fully explain visible account/newsletter features
Implementation: Updated actual data-flow/privacy wording; removed public fallback for private storage; added signed unsubscribe confirmation and opt-in controls for optional services.
Verification: Private-failure and token-tamper tests pass; no public private-key copies found; no test email sent.
Remaining: Owner must confirm retention, postal details, processing terms and jurisdiction-specific consent requirements. Real mail/account operations were not tested with live personal data.

Issue: Homepage capture copy says existing tools have not launched
Implementation: Rewrote update signup copy, corrected calendar branding and placed product links before the optional signup.
Verification: Homepage mobile visual check and source order reviewed.
Remaining: No claim that already available tools are waiting to launch remains in the hero signup.

Issue: Vehicle database counts and categories disagree
Implementation: Derived counts from the current catalog, normalized plural category aliases, implemented actual local history and pagination.
Verification: Catalog records/category counts and user-state behavior checked; no fabricated 312 total or history count.
Remaining: Saved/history counts are per browser and are not cloud analytics.

Issue: Local type checking fails in three locations
Implementation: Used the correct production-aligned branch; all new unknown/numeric states are explicit.
Verification: TypeScript and production build pass; original stale-checkout errors were not treated as live failures.
Remaining: The original modified checkout was left intact.

Issue: Related cards can repeat stronger claims than cautious article body
Implementation: Backed up and corrected both map articles' body, excerpt and search descriptions together; withdrew unsupported developer ratios.
Verification: Four article changes saved transactionally and read back; related cards consume updated excerpts.
Remaining: Future quantitative claims require a traceable current primary source.

Issue: Favicon returns 404 in Lighthouse
Implementation: Added actual favicon ICO and Taish Gaming publisher PNG.
Verification: HTTP check confirms favicon 200 with image MIME type.
Remaining: Additional app icon sizes may be added when a PWA is implemented.

Issue: Growth attribution and crawl diagnosis require private data
Implementation: Added opt-in, route-sanitized Web Vitals reporting hooks and documented the measurement boundary.
Verification: Local events and default-disabled optional-service delivery reviewed; no invented traffic baseline.
Remaining: Owner access to GSC, GA4/Plausible, Bing, CDN/server logs and production field data is still required.

Issue: Mobile article TOC delays the substantive answer
Implementation: Placed the article answer/excerpt ahead of navigation and made the TOC an accessible closed disclosure.
Verification: Article HTTP and mobile checks confirm details markup and direct access to the answer.
Remaining: Article-specific fact checking remains an editorial responsibility.
